corridor_noticeboard.title: Noticeboard
corridor_noticeboard.speaker: protagonist
corridor_noticeboard.text: An evacuation plan squeezed up against a class photo. Three rows of faces in the photo. The plan has a red dot for you.
corridor_noticeboard.repeat_text: Someone in the bottom row blinked. The red dot is right next to his shoulder.

record.text: The evacuation plan is pinned beside a class photo on the corridor board.

corridor_extinguisher.title: Fire extinguisher
corridor_extinguisher.speaker: protagonist
corridor_extinguisher.text: A hole punched through the inspection tag. Tilt your head and a digit shows through, from the phone number on the wall.
corridor_extinguisher.repeat_text: Just the one digit. The tag covers the rest.

record.text: The extinguisher’s inspection tag covers part of a number written on the wall.

corridor_classroom_glass.title: Classroom window
corridor_classroom_glass.prompt: Jump to look through the glass
corridor_classroom_glass.speaker: protagonist
corridor_classroom_glass.text: On the way up you catch a few rows of desk legs. Then the sill cuts the whole room off again.
corridor_classroom_glass.repeat_text: This time you look for the board first. Your shoes come down before you find it.

record.text: A glimpse of rows of desks through the high window. Not enough to pick out my seat.

corridor_high_window.title: High classroom window
corridor_high_window.prompt: Jump to look through the high window
corridor_high_window.speaker: protagonist
corridor_high_window.text: A few empty desks through the slit. The last one’s further back than you expected. Then your feet are down again.

corridor_folded_directory.title: Building directory
corridor_folded_directory.speaker: protagonist
corridor_folded_directory.text: “01 →” on one side. “← 01” on the other. Both numbers again over the glass doors. There’s a narrow tab in a slot beneath the directory.

record.text: The glass entrance is marked 01 twice. On the directory the two 01s point in opposite directions.
